lines.text: The psalm calls for a new song to the LORD in the assembly of the godly, and Zion's children rejoice in their King.
Israel is to praise His name with dancing and make music to Him with tambourine and trumpet.
The LORD takes pleasure in His people and adorns the afflicted with salvation, and the saints shout for joy upon their beds.
High praises of God are in the saints' mouths and a double-edged sword is in their hands to inflict vengeance on the nations.
The saints bind the nations' kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of bronze, to execute the judgment written against them.
